'''E-B0W''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[strummer]] and a member of the [[Leisurenauts]], an all-droid [[Music/Legends|musical]] [[Band/Legends|band]] that performed in [[Kaas City]]'s [[Nexus Room]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=location|Nexus Room Cantina|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>
